projectionDiagnosticCode shared by every refusal path

conflicts.lib/journal/atomic_notebook_store.dart: resolved by keeping the published storage form: construction goes through one _refuseReservedTarget that uses _targetsReservedNotebook, the typed failed build of the replacement envelope is kept and now receives the canonical offered snapshot, and the narrowed catches with _discardTemp cleanup are kept verbatim. Projection stays additive: projectionBaseline field, projectionValidated constructor, stored check before admission, offered check before the same-notebook check and before any temp file.
conflicts.PROCESS.jsonl: published 46 lines kept byte-identical as an unchanged prefix; the 3 projection events appended after them

semantic_collision_found: the published storage covers the whole offered snapshot in validateNotebookSnapshot and requires a non-format error from a broken caller snapshot to propagate; the projection layer canonicalizes the caller object and never consults its getters, so a throwing getter had silently become a typed projectionMismatch
semantic_collision_resolution: validateNotebookSnapshot is called once on the caller snapshot before canonicalization, inside the lock. Only EnvelopeFormatException falls through, because the canonical form still decides the outcome; any other error propagates unchanged and the temp file is never created. The caller object still never influences what is compared, persisted, or returned.
single_canonicalization_point: CanonicalSnapshot.tryCanonicalize is called exactly once per commit, inside the per-path lock; that decoded value is used for the projection comparison, the same-notebook check, the replacement envelope, and the returned envelope
refusal_order: replacement envelope build, typed failed on format rejection
